card.name: Words just before "fatal" or "lethal"
card.fires_on: Words right before a predicted "fatal", "lethal" or "LD50", mostly in overdose or toxicity text. Examples are "potentially", "median", "oral", "intravenous" and "usually".

modes.label: Qualifier before fatal
modes.description: Adverbs or "is" that sit just before the word "fatal" in overdose statements.

modes.label: Animal lethal-dose wording
modes.description: Route or statistic words before "LD50" or "lethal dose" in animal toxicity sentences.
modes.example: The oral<< median>> lethal dose in rats is 7 mg

modes.label: Start of fatal
modes.description: The first letter of "fatal" in an all-caps warning heading.
modes.example: SERIOUS AND SOMETIMES<< F>>ATAL DERMATOLOGIC REA

card.writes: It pushes the model toward completing with "fatal", "lethal" or "LD".
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say that something is fatal or give a lethal dose.
